verdict: Paid lead flow is strong and cheap this period; the weak link is intake speed and Instagram organic reach.
diagnosis: Meta ads produced 220 leads at roughly $27 each this period — far below the $180 Meta legal benchmark.

signals.headline: 220 leads at $27 each
signals.detail: Meta spent $6,028 and delivered 220 form leads this period. Cost per lead sits well under legal industry norms.

signals.headline: 11 new 5-star reviews added
signals.detail: Google profile gained 11 reviews this period, holding a perfect 5.0 average across 122 total. Strong trust signal.

signals.headline: 121 phone calls from Google
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove 121 call clicks this period. This is your highest-intent channel and it is working.

signals.headline: 1,198 landing page views, 220 leads

signals.detail: Organic Instagram has near-zero audience despite paid activity. The ad account is doing all the work alone.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Your $27 lead cost beats legal norms
benchmark.body: Median Meta cost per lead for law firms is around $180, and bankruptcy — the closest analog to debt-collector defense — averages $82 per lead. Your $27 is exceptional for the category.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: Consumer debt and collector-harassment searches typically climb through summer as credit card balances peak post-spring spending. Expect steady or rising demand into August before a Labor Day dip.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: Only 28% of law firms respond to leads within five minutes, yet doing so lifts conversion up to 21x. Competitors are investing in instant-response intake to steal your top-of-funnel wins.

recommendations.title: Test a one-minute response rule on Meta leads
recommendations.detail: Consider auto-texting every new lead within 60 seconds. Industry data shows this can lift signed cases sharply and protects your low $27 lead cost from wasted intake.

recommendations.title: Scale the winning campaign while economics hold
recommendations.detail: The Instant Forms video campaign is well below benchmark. Worth testing a 25–40% budget lift on the top ad before auction costs normalize.

recommendations.title: Repurpose paid video into organic Instagram Reels
recommendations.detail: With only 28 followers, the profile adds no lift. Test posting the paid creative organically to build a retargeting audience and social proof.
